stories.title: BlackRock Turns Bullish on Short-Term Bonds, Ends US Stock Overweight
stories.summary: BlackRock has changed its market stance. The firm now favors short-term bonds. It also closed its overweight position on US stocks. The shift signals a change in BlackRock's asset allocation outlook.
stories.whyItMatters: BlackRock manages trillions in assets. A shift in its stance can influence how other investors position their portfolios.
whatToWatch: Whether other large asset managers make similar shifts.
Further detail from BlackRock on its new bond and equity targets.
questions: What specific risks prompted the change?
How long does BlackRock expect this stance to last?

stories.title: Fed's Hammack: Aims to Cool Inflation Without Harming the Job Market
stories.summary: Fed official Hammack said she hopes to cool demand and inflation. She wants this to happen without pain in the job market. The remark points to the Fed's ongoing balance between inflation control and employment.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed officials' comments on this balance shape rate expectations, which move stocks and bonds.
whatToWatch: Upcoming Fed speeches and meetings for similar comments.
Job market data for signs of cooling demand.
questions: What specific steps does Hammack favor to achieve this?
Does she see rate cuts as part of the path forward?

stories.whyItMatters: The CPI report will shape Fed rate expectations, which affect gold, bonds, and stocks together.
whatToWatch: This week's CPI release.
Dollar and oil price moves ahead of the report.
questions: Will CPI come in above or below expectations?
